proposals.evidence: DEDR4240 gives Tamil pukai, Malayalam puka, Kannada/Kodagu poge, Tulu pugè/pogè, Telugu poga and Gondi poya/poyo/poī smoke. Selected survey p-/h-/zero-initial and intervocalic k/g/h/y forms preserve that family; voga/voge have a glide onset following initial-consonant loss. Source vowel and consonant notation is retained, while opaque longer responses are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR4494 gives Kannada poṭṭe/poḍe/puṭṭi, Telugu/Parji poṭṭa and Gondi poṭa/poṭṭa belly. Kannada/nearby oṭṭ-/voṭṭ-/hoṭṭ- responses reflect initial p weakening/loss with glide or h onset; Gadaba puḍu/puḍḍu are neighbouring comparative voiced-stop forms. These proposed lect extensions retain source vowels; Prakrit poṭṭa comparison does not settle borrowing direction. The competing vaṭṭi-type family is explicitly excluded and held. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
